Title: Data Scientist - Machine Learning
Description:
¿Por qué te estamos buscando?

Tu misión será impulsar la capacidad de Data Science dentro del equipo de Data&IA en Mahou San Miguel, trabajando activamente con las diferentes áreas de negocio, en el desarrollo de modelos de Advanced Analytics e IA (ML, DP…), que ayuden a los negocios, a tomar mejores decisiones, generar eficiencias operativas, reducción de costes o nuevos modelos de negocio, obteniendo así, un beneficio real y tangible a las distintas áreas usuarias.

Tu día a día en Mahou San Miguel


Desarrollar casos de uso de analítica avanzada y gestión de proveedores.
Tomar requisitos con las áreas de negocio desde un punto de vista técnico, para aterrizar junto al resto de equipo de Dato & IA.
Analizar la información de las distintas fuentes de datos, internas y externas, para identificar la idoneidad necesaria para desarrollar un proyecto de datos posterior.
Diseñar y desarrollar pipelines de datos en plataformas cloud de Data & IA (transformaciones, pipeline builder, object sets, contour workflows) garantizando calidad, trazabilidad y escalabilidad.
Industrializar y monitorizar modelos junto al equipo de MLOps, asegurando su despliegue, gobernanza y mantenimiento en producción.


Colaborar con expertos funcionales para traducir necesidades de negocio en soluciones analíticas completas.


Contribuir a la evolución del ecosistema de datos de MSM mediante la definición de estándares, buenas prácticas y automatización.
Participar en la comunidad de práctica de datos e IA, impulsando la formación, el intercambio de conocimiento y la innovación interna.


¿Qué requisitos debes cumplir?


Grado o Máster en Ingeniería, Matemáticas, Estadística, Física o disciplinas afines.
Nivel fluido de inglés conversacional
Mínimo de 3 a 6 años de experiencia en proyectos de Data Science o Data Engineering.
Experiencia en plataformas Data Science: Palantir Foundry, Azure ML, Vertex AI, SageMaker o SAS Viya.
Conocimientos avanzados de MLOps (Airflow, MLflow, Kubeflow o similares).
Experiencia en el desarrollo y despliegue de modelos de ML en entornos productivos.
Experiencia con herramientas de versionado, CI/CD, APIs y notebooks.
Competencias técnicas: - Lenguajes: Python, SQL, PySpark.
Frameworks: scikit-learn, MLflow, TensorFlow/PyTorch (valorado).
Entornos Cloud: Azure, AWS o GCP.
Conocimientos de DataOps y MLOps.


La diversidad, clave en nuestra estrategia

Nuestro compromiso con la diversidad, la inclusión y la igualdad de oportunidades está presente desde nuestro nacimiento en 1890. Nuestra visión, en este sentido, es “construir el futuro a través de la suma de personas únicas, impulsando la diversidad de forma activa como fuente de riqueza en la sociedad”.

Por eso, esta oferta está dirigida a cualquier persona que reúna los requisitos exigidos para el puesto, independientemente de sus características.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Sobre Fintonic




En Fintonic estamos en pleno renacer. Tenemos más de 12 años de historia como referente del mundo fintech en España, y hoy comenzamos un nuevo capítulo: más ambicioso, más dinámico, más emocionante. ¿El objetivo? Convertirnos en el estándar definitivo del score crediticio y en el principal marketplace de financiación al consumo, gracias a una tecnología superior y un dominio absoluto del uso de los datos.




Nos respaldan inversores institucionales de primer nivel como ING Ventures y SquareOne Capital. Estamos formando un nuevo equipo que no solo se suma al viaje, sino que lo lidera.




💪Tu misión




Buscamos un perfil mid para Fintonic cuya misión será desarrollar soluciones de analítica avanzada y machine learning orientadas al análisis de riesgo, automatización de procesos y mejora continua del negocio.




¿Qué harás?




Desarrollo y mantenimiento del ecosistema de servicios asociados al análisis de riesgo de los usuarios, aplicando técnicas de analítica avanzada y Machine Learning. Esto incluye la implementación de modelos de scoring, categorización de transacciones, detección de comercios, extracción automática de información financiera, detección de fraude, listas negras (blacklists), control de calidad de datos y sistemas de sanción (Wanna).
Brindar soporte diario y resolución de incidencias relacionadas con los sistemas de analítica avanzada, en colaboración con agentes del call center y analistas de riesgo.
Mejora general de procesos de Advanced Analytics




💫Sobre ti




Tienes una titulación en Estadística, Matemáticas, Ingeniería, Informática, Ciencia de Datos o campos afines.
Tienes 2 años de experiencia trabajando en proyectos de ciencia de datos aplicados a negocio dentro del sector financiero.
Tienes experiencia ejecutando iniciativas de machine learning en entornos productivos y colaborando con perfiles multidisciplinares (analistas, ingenieros, producto, soporte).
IMPRESCINDIBLE contar con experiencia previa en la construcción y mantenimiento de modelos de riesgo, detección de fraude, o motores de scoring (idealmente en fintech o banca digital).
Dominas Python para análisis de datos, machine learning y automatización.
Has utilizado Visual Studio Code como entorno de desarrollo.
Controlas versiones con GitLab
Tienes conocimientos en Docker para contenerización y despliegue de modelos en producción.
Usas servicios en la nube, especialmente AWS.
Trabajas con bases de datos relacionales y no relacionales: MongoDB, Redshift, MySQL.
Tienes conocimientos en visualización de datos, documentación técnica y gestión de tareas: Google Sheets, Confluence, Jira.
Monitoreo de sistemas y rendimiento con Datadog.




Habilidades y Competencias que necesitarás:




Capacidad para traducir necesidades de negocio en soluciones técnicas escalables y sostenibles.
Alta capacidad analítica, orientación a resultados y pensamiento crítico.
Buenas habilidades de comunicación para interactuar con equipos técnicos y no técnicos.
Resolución ágil de incidencias en producción y soporte técnico colaborativo.




Lo que te ofrecemos




Disfrutarás de retribución flexible: tickets restaurante, transporte, seguro médico, guardería, formación
Programas de desarrollo profesional
Clases de inglés
Formación técnica y en habilidades blandas
Ayuda al deporte
24 días de vacaciones + 24 o 31 de diciembre
Seguro de vida una vez superado el periodo de prueba
Y en tu cumple 🎂, tendrás la tarde libre




🚀Conoce nuestros principios y valores




Ganamos la confianza siendo transparentes
Los datos son nuestro superpoder
Hacemos pocas cosas, pero las hacemos excepcionalmente bien
Siempre cumplimos nuestras promesas
Resolvemos las cosas con ingenio




💙 En Fintonic, creemos en el poder de la diversidad. Nuestro equipo está formado por personas de diferentes culturas, trayectorias y formas de ser. No discriminamos por orientación sexual, identidad o expresión de género, ni por ninguna otra condición personal. Si compartes nuestros valores, ¡nos encantará conocerte!

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
About Us

Prime Insights is a Sweden-based technology company reaching millions of diverse users through our proprietary Market Research Panel. Beyond our world-class Market Research Panel, we are scaling our Offerwall and Play-to-Earn (P2E) ecosystems. We connect millions of users to games and products they love, leveraging sophisticated targeting to ensure high engagement for advertisers and maximum rewards for our users.

As part of our Central Data Team, you will be the backbone of our intelligence, building the models and systems that power our international community.




We are looking for a Data Scientist who can build predictive models, recommendation systems, and experimentation frameworks to improve user engagement, LTV, and fraud detection in a high-scale product environment. Experience in AdTech, Gaming, or similar industries is a strong plus.




What You’ll Do

Predictive Targeting & Personalization: Build recommendation engines that match the right offer (game/survey) to the right user at the right time to maximise user engagement.
User Lifetime Value (LTV) Modeling: Develop models to predict long-term user value and churn, allowing us to optimize user acquisition spend.
Fraud & Anomaly Detection: Guard the ecosystem by building real-time systems to detect "farming," bot behavior, and VPN spoofing.
Statistical Rigor: Serve as the internal consultant for experimentation (A/B testing) design, ensuring results are statistically significant and unbiased.
Advanced Analytics: Move beyond descriptive reporting into diagnostic and predictive analytics.




What We’re Looking For

3+ years of experience in Data Science, ideally within AdTech, Gaming, or FinTech.
Core Tech Stack: Expert proficiency in Python (Scikit-learn, XGBoost/LightGBM/CatBoost, PyTorch) and Advanced SQL.
AdTech Knowledge: Familiarity with concepts like CPM, ROAS, Attribution, and Post-back loops.
Strong communication skills: Able to clearly explain findings, assumptions, and tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Experimental Design: Deep understanding of A/B testing in high-traffic environments where "noise" is high.
Product Curiosity: You don’t just build models; you want to understand the psychology of why a user clicks one game over another.




How to Apply

Use the Easy Apply button.

❗Important: We are not considering freelancers working on multiple projects simultaneously. This is a full-time position for a dedicated Data Scientist who is ready to commit to a single product ecosystem and contribute meaningfully to its long-term success.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
¿Quiénes somos?

Somos una compañía tecnológica especializada en Inteligencia Artificial, IA Generativa, Analytics, Gobierno del Dato, Cloud y arquitecturas Event Driven, pero sobre todo somos un equipo con conocimiento, criterio y muchas ganas de hacer las cosas bien.

Trabajamos con talento altamente especializado, esté donde esté, y apostamos por una forma de crecer basada en la confianza, la autonomía y la participación. Nos mueve la excelencia tecnológica, la orientación a negocio y el sentido común, pero también el entusiasmo, la creatividad y la convicción de que la tecnología necesita alma, propósito y personas capaces de convertir la complejidad en soluciones reales.




¿Qué buscamos?

Buscamos a un/a Data Scientist enfocado en forecasting de series temporales para el área de Finanzas con 2 años de experiencia en responsabilidades similares. Perfil con base técnica sólida - escribir buen código y manejarse con soltura en el desarrollo, aunque la productivización final se aborde en colaboración con Data Engineers.

Grado en Data Science, Informática, Ingeniería, Matemáticas, Estadística, Finanzas cuantitativas o afín (MS/PhD valorable).
Python sólido, con buenas prácticas de desarrollo (código limpio, testeado, versionado).
PySpark para procesamiento distribuido de datos a gran escala.
Experiencia demostrable en forecasting de series temporales (clásico y/o ML).
Aplicación de técnicas de ML sobre datasets grandes (clustering, clasificación, regresión, detección de anomalías).
SQL para acceso y transformación de datos.
Comprensión sólida de metodologías ágiles.
Inglés profesional.




Será un PLUS:

Dominio financiero (planificación, riesgo, FP&A, tesorería).
Tecnologías de bases de datos en cloud (p. ej. AWS) y despliegue en infraestructura cloud de datos/analítica.
Contenedores y pipelines/microservicios (Docker, Kubernetes).
Herramientas de dashboarding (Dash, Tableau).




¿Cómo será tu día a día?

Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener modelos de forecasting de series temporales (métodos estadísticos clásicos —ARIMA/SARIMA, suavizado exponencial, modelos de espacio de estados— y enfoques ML/probabilísticos) aplicados a problemáticas financieras.
Escribir código limpio, ordenado y bien documentado en Python, aplicando buenas prácticas (modularidad, pruebas, control de versiones) para que los modelos sean reproducibles y mantenibles.
Procesar y modelar datos a gran escala con PySpark, construyendo pipelines eficientes sobre datasets financieros voluminosos.
Crear modelos repetibles, interpretables, dinámicos y escalables, y colaborar con data engineers y leads de negocio en su integración en aplicaciones y herramientas.
Ingeniería de features combinando fuentes internas y externas para mejorar la precisión predictiva.
Apoyar la monitorización, mantenimiento y mejora de los modelos una vez en uso.
Comunicar el enfoque analítico (relevancia, trade-offs) a partners de negocio y traducir resultados a implicaciones financieras accionables.
Trabajar de forma iterativa e incremental en un equipo ágil cross-funcional, buscando mejorar velocidad y calidad sprint a sprint.




¿Qué ofrecemos?

Pertenecer a una empresa a la vanguardia tecnológica y centrada en las Personas, ponemos al trabajador en el centro de todo lo que hacemos. Creemos en una cultura horizontal, sin egos, en un entorno donde se valoran tanto las ideas como las personas.

Contrato indefinido y salario entre los 28.000 y 34.000 euros brutos/año de entrada, ajustado según tu experiencia (nuestro plan de carrera incluye 2 revisiones anuales). También tendrás a tu disposición un plan de formación especializado, participación en la propiedad y los beneficios de Mática: Wetaca gratuito en la oficina dos días a la semana, horario flexible con facilidades para trabajar desde donde quieras, seguro de salud, retribución flexible con Cobee, además de las vacaciones habituales, ofrecemos una semana extra en Navidad y tres días adicionales en Semana Santa.

También recibirás un divertido Welcome Kit con portátil (podrás escoger entre varios modelos Mac o Windows), móvil, botella personalizada, auriculares bluetooth y golosinas.

Cuando estés en nuestra oficina, en el centro de Barcelona o Madrid, la fruta, los cafés y los refrescos corren a cuenta de Mática. ¡Ah! Y si eres amante de los animales, te gustará saber esto: ¡nuestras oficinas son Pet-friendly!




Si te interesa, escríbenos por LinkedIn o envía tu CV a seleccion@maticapartners.com

Title: Data Scientist
Place: Las Rozas de Madrid, Community of Madrid, Spain
Description:
Data Scientist

We are looking for a motivated and experienced Data Scientist to join the Analytics team of a leading company specialising in real estate data and technology.

Data analysis and the development of data-driven digital products are at the heart of the organisation. In this role, you will help design and develop predictive models and advanced analytical solutions using complex and heterogeneous data.

You will work closely with both technical and business teams, contributing to innovative projects with a real impact on clients and the organisation. This is an excellent opportunity to combine modelling, data engineering and applied analytics in a dynamic environment.




Location: Las Rozas, Madrid

Working model: Hybrid

Employment type: Full-time

Reporting to: Head of Data Science

Languages: Fluent Spanish and English




Key responsibilities

Explore, transform and structure large volumes of complex and heterogeneous data to generate meaningful insights.
Design, train and continuously improve predictive models for internal initiatives and client-facing projects.
Create new variables and indicators by applying machine learning techniques to business and real estate challenges.
Optimise and evolve analytical pipelines and processes to improve efficiency, scalability and quality.
Identify, integrate and leverage new external data sources to enrich existing models and broaden their impact.




What we’re looking for

A degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Engineering or another related discipline with a strong statistical and mathematical foundation.
At least two years of proven experience working on analytical or data science projects.
Advanced programming skills in Python and/or R.
Solid knowledge of statistical methodologies, including multivariate statistics, networks, machine learning and related techniques.
Experience handling, processing and analysing large volumes of data.
Fluent Spanish and English.
A Master’s degree in Data Science or similar specialised training would be highly valued.It would be a plus if you have experience with
Cloud environments.
Distributed programming with Spark.
Spatial data and GIS tools, such as QGIS or Carto.
Non-relational databases.
Real estate data or a strong interest in the real estate sector.




The person we’re looking for

Curious, proactive and eager to continue learning.
Analytical, organised and highly attentive to detail.
Comfortable working with multidisciplinary teams.
Able to communicate complex findings clearly, both verbally and in writing.
Equipped with a practical mindset and strong problem-solving skills.




What we offer

The opportunity to contribute to the future of a growing, data-driven organisation.
A hybrid working model based in Las Rozas, Madrid.
A passionate and collaborative team focused on delivering high-quality solutions.
A competitive salary and benefits package.
A supportive environment where collaboration, initiative and continuous learning are encouraged.
Opportunities for professional growth and development.
An international, dynamic and forward-looking working environment.
An inclusive workplace committed to equal opportunities and professional development.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
¿Te motiva extraer valor de los datos, construir modelos predictivos y llevar soluciones analíticas a producción? ¡Queremos conocerte!

Buscamos una persona especializada en Data Science para desarrollar modelos avanzados, trabajar con grandes volúmenes de datos y desplegar soluciones en entornos cloud Azure, en proyectos reales de alto impacto.




¿Qué harás en tu día a día?




➡️ Analizar grandes volúmenes de datos para extraer insights accionables que apoyen la toma de decisiones.

➡️ Desarrollar, entrenar y validar modelos de machine learning y estadística avanzada.

➡️ Trabajar con Python y sus principales librerías (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, etc.) para el procesamiento y modelado de datos.

➡️ Implementar y desplegar modelos en entornos Azure (Azure Machine Learning, Azure Databricks, etc.).

➡️ Colaborar con equipos de Data Engineering para asegurar la correcta ingesta y disponibilidad de datos.

➡️ Diseñar experimentos y evaluar el rendimiento de modelos mediante métricas adecuadas.

➡️ Integrar modelos en aplicaciones o servicios orientados a negocio.

➡️ Documentar modelos, procesos analíticos y decisiones técnicas.




Encajarás perfectamente si…




✔️ Tienes experiencia de 3 años como Data Scientist o en roles similares.

✔️ Dominas Python aplicado a análisis de datos y machine learning.

✔️ Tienes experiencia con librerías de ciencia de datos (Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, etc.).

✔️ Has trabajado en entornos cloud, especialmente Azure.

✔️ Conoces técnicas de modelado estadístico y machine learning.

✔️ Tienes experiencia en visualización de datos y comunicación de resultados.

✔️ Tienes mentalidad analítica, orientación a resultados y buenas habilidades de comunicación.




Y sería un plus si además…




⭐ Has trabajado con Azure Machine Learning o Azure Databricks.

⭐ Tienes experiencia en despliegue de modelos (MLOps).

⭐ Conoces herramientas de versionado y seguimiento de experimentos.

⭐ Has trabajado con datos en tiempo real o modelos de predicción en producción.

⭐ Te interesa la optimización de modelos y su escalabilidad.




¿Qué ofrecemos?




✅ Proyectos tecnológicos retadores en entornos modernos de datos.

✅ Buen ambiente de trabajo y colaboración entre equipos técnicos.

✅ Plan de desarrollo profesional y formación continua.

✅ Horario flexible y posibilidad de teletrabajo / modalidad híbrida.

✅ Beneficios adicionales: seguro médico, formaciones, equipo técnico y más.

Title: Data Scientist - Machine Learning
Description:
Capgemini Engineering, líder mundial en servicios de ingeniería, reúne a equipos de profesionales en ingeniería, ciencia y tecnología para ayudar a las empresas más innovadoras del mundo a liberar su potencial y contribuir a un futuro mejor. Desde coches autónomos hasta robots que salvan vidas, nuestro/as expertos/as en tecnologías digitales y software se salen de lo convencional proporcionando servicios únicos de I+D e ingeniería en todos los sectores de actividad. ¡Únete al equipo y continua tu carrera en una compañía con oportunidades de crecimiento, donde puedes marcar la diferencia y donde ningún día es igual al anterior!

Acerca del rol

Desde Capgemini Engineering buscamos un/a Data Scientist - Machine Learning para incorporarse a un proyecto tecnológico del sector aeronáutico. La persona seleccionada participará en el desarrollo de soluciones de Machine Learning y analítica predictiva, trabajando desde la preparación y análisis de los datos hasta la implementación y monitorización de modelos en entornos productivos.

¿Qué harás en el proyecto?


Analizar, procesar y transformar datos estructurados y no estructurados.
Diseñar, desarrollar y validar modelos de Machine Learning y analítica predictiva.
Realizar análisis exploratorios para identificar patrones y generar insights relevantes.
Participar en el despliegue y monitorización de modelos en entornos productivos.
Colaborar con equipos de negocio, ingeniería y producto para identificar oportunidades basadas en datos.
Elaborar visualizaciones, informes y presentaciones para comunicar los resultados obtenidos.
Participar en iniciativas de inteligencia artificial y analítica avanzada.


Tu perfil

Para sentirte a gusto en esta posición se requieren conocimientos en:


Formación en Ingeniería, Informática, Matemáticas, Estadística, Física o similar.
Entre 3 y 5 años de experiencia como Data Scientist, Machine Learning Engineer o en posiciones similares.
Dominio de Python y librerías de análisis y Machine Learning como Pandas, NumPy y Scikit-learn.
Experiencia desarrollando modelos de aprendizaje supervisado y no supervisado.
Conocimientos de SQL y experiencia trabajando con bases de datos relacionales.
Experiencia en el tratamiento y análisis de grandes volúmenes de datos.


Se valorará positivamente el poseer certificado de discapacidad, en el marco de nuestra política de inclusión y diversidad.

Valoramos todas las candidaturas. Contamos con una amplia oferta formativa y programas de certificación. Aunque no cumplas el 100% de los requisitos, ¡nos encantará conocerte!

¿Qué te gustará de trabajar aquí?

Ofrecemos un entorno flexible y con oportunidades de crecimiento:


Un ambiente de trabajo único muy valorado por nuestros profesionales en las evaluaciones periódicas.
Wellbeing HUB - Incluye políticas y acciones para la salud física (Wellhub) y mental.
24 días de vacaciones + 2 asuntos propios + 24 y 31 de diciembre + opción a comprar hasta 7 días de vacaciones al año.
FlexAbroad: posibilidad de trabajar en remoto desde otro país durante 45 días.
Plan de Compensación Flexible (seguro médico, transporte, formación, tarjeta restaurante o subvención de comida, guardería…)
Formación continua, podrás disfrutar de Mylearning y de Capgemini University y de nuestros Campus Digitales y Comunidades profesionales. Tendrás acceso a plataformas como: Coursera, Udemy, Pluralsight, Harvard Manager Mentor, Education First para idiomas (inglés francés, alemán…) ¡entre otras!
Participación en Acciones de Voluntariado y Acción Social con nuestros Grupos de Sostenibilidad, Inclusión e Igualdad.
Acompañamiento en tus inicios con el programa de Buddies.
Seguro de Vida y Accidentes

Capgemini es líder global en transformación digital y gestión de negocios, impulsando un futuro inclusivo y sostenible mediante la tecnología. Contamos con más de 360.000 profesionales en más de 50 países.

Nuestro compromiso con la igualdad de oportunidades se refleja en nuestro Plan de Igualdad y Código Ético, garantizando un entorno libre de discriminación por origen, etnia, nacionalidad, género, edad, orientación sexual, identidad de género, religión o cualquier otra circunstancia personal o social.

Description:
Desde la División de AI&Data estamos buscando un/a Data Scientist para una organización de ámbito internacional líder mundial en información, servicios personalizados y defensa de los derechos de los usuarios , con el objetivo de liderar proyectos analíticos y aportar los insights necesarios para guiar las decisiones estratégicas de la dirección corporativa.




Funciones:

Gestionar proyectos analíticos de principio a fin (end-to-end).
Recopilar, limpiar y transformar datos provenientes de múltiples fuentes para adecuarlos a su posterior análisis.
Analizar la información empleando métodos estadísticos para identificar patrones, tendencias y relaciones en los datos(AB Test y análisis de supervivencia)
Construir y desarrollar modelos predictivos (estadísticos y de machine learning) para pronosticar resultados o clasificar información.
Traducir resultados analíticos complejos en insights claros y comprensibles a través de visualizaciones, reportes y presentaciones.
Definir los requerimientos analíticos del proyecto, identificando las necesidades técnicas, de infraestructura y de datos.




Requisitos:

Titulación de Máster o equivalente en Informática (IT), Estadística o áreas relacionadas.
Experiencia mínima de 2 años desempeñando funciones en un rol de Data Science.
Nivel excelente de inglés(C1), tanto hablado como escrito.(día a día 100% en Ingles)
Fluidez programando en los lenguajes Python o R.
SQL Expert.
Metodología estadística profunda con conocimientos de herramientas como AB test, Análisis de supervivencia .
Alta capacidad de storytelling: habilidad para comunicar conclusiones estadísticas avanzadas de forma clara a audiencias variadas.




Valorable:

Experiencia profesional trabajando con el ecosistema de Microsoft Azure y Databricks.

Contrato indefinido a jornada completa (35 horas semanales).
Modelo hibrido de trabajo y horario flexible.

Seguro medico
Entorno de trabajo con un fuerte propósito social, orientado a la igualdad de oportunidades y al balance entre la vida personal y profesional.

Title: Data Scientist, Applied Science
Description:
Do you want to drive the next urban revolution? At Cabify, that’s what we’re doing. We aim to make cities better places to live by improving mobility for the people living in them, connecting riders to drivers at the touch of a button. Maybe one day cities will be places where nobody needs a private car. But we’ve still got a long way to go… want to be part of this journey?

About The Position

You will join Cabify’s Applied Science team, a group of highly motivated data scientists with access to all data within the organization. The team is involved in all main areas of the company, including vehicle and route management, understanding user experience, pricing, fraud detection, and marketing optimization (see for yourself: exhibit A, exhibit B, exhibit C). You will work with state-of-the-art tools and infrastructure to help improve everyday operations in more than 40 cities worldwide. Cabify's Applied Science team provides a unique opportunity to research, test and implement great ideas that will shape the future of our cities.

As a Data Scientist in our team, you will:


Develop high-impact data science projects, working closely with other data, engineering, product and business teams.
Design, train, and validate statistical and machine learning models and help deploying them into production.
Participate in the results analysis of real-life experiments, following academy-standard scientific methods and procedures, to demonstrate the impact of the new product features we develop.
Help to convert the team’s technical knowledge into real and tangible business insights that bring value to the company.
Join product development conversations, discussing new features and bringing the data science perspective to everything we build.


What we’re looking for


At least 3 years of professional experience working as a data scientist or equivalent research role.
Strong educational background, e.g Masters in Computer Science, Physics, Engineering, Mathematics, Economics, etc.
Solid foundations in Probability & Statistics.
Experience designing, training and validating statistical and machine learning models.
Experience working with Python for data analysis and data visualization libraries.
Experience with data extraction and processing. Capable of writing complex SQL code.
Ability to work autonomously in an unstructured environment.


Bonus Points


Experience bringing machine learning to production, with all its subtleties: deploying, training, testing, model degradation, model serving, etc.
Experience with state-of-the-art methods in topics like deep learning models, time series analysis, bayesian statistics, causal inference, etc.
Experience with geo data modeling, analysis and visualization.


What’s it like to work at Cabify?

We’re a company full of happy, motivated people and we never want that to change. Here are some more reasons why it rocks to be part of our high-performance team:

💶 Excellent Salary conditions: 38K - 53K€

🌍 Our office is located in Madrid.

⌚ Flexible work environment & hours.

🙌 Regular team events.

🚗 Cabify staff free rides.

🚀 Personal development programs based on our career paths.

📐 Coursera: your own license in Coursera to take as many courses as you wish and continue developing your skills.

🧘‍♀️ iFeel: Free access to the iFeel platform, so you can take care of your emotional well-being through therapy sessions.

💳 Flexible compensation plan: Restaurant tickets, transport tickets, healthcare and childcare

🐱 A pet room ,so you don’t have to leave your furry friend at home

☕️ And last but not least...free coffee and fruit!

Cabify is proud of being an equal opportunity workplace. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees regardless of background, gender, religion, orientation, age or ability.

Join us!

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITHAbout Coro℠

The Coro℠ business unit brings together Bain’s proprietary suite of software-as-a-service (SaaS) and data-as-a-service (DaaS) tools, including cloud-based software, online capability assessments, and advanced analytics, focused on enabling Commercial Excellence for B2B companies.

You’ll work closely with data scientists, data engineers, and software engineers to develop sophisticated approaches to entity resolution at scale. Your focus will be on experimentation and model quality, while your engineering partners will help bring successful approaches into production.

WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM

As a Senior Applied Data Scientist, you’ll focus on one of the most challenging problems in large-scale data: determining when records from different sources refer to the same real-world business.

You’ll develop and test machine learning, embedding, and large language model (LLM) approaches that improve how we match and resolve complex entity data. You’ll explore how far emerging foundation-model techniques can improve match quality while ensuring solutions remain practical, scalable, and cost-effective across hundreds of millions of entities.

This is a highly applied role where you’ll have the opportunity to experiment with emerging AI techniques, measure their impact, and work with engineering teams to turn the strongest ideas into scalable solutions.

WHAT YOU’LL DODevelop Smarter Entity Matching
Build and evaluate machine learning, embedding, and LLM-based approaches for entity resolution
Improve how our systems handle complex and messy data, including name variations, aliases, domains, websites, firmographic attributes, multilingual records, and data hierarchies
Develop scoring and ranking approaches that distinguish genuine matches from lookalikes, duplicates, and unrelated entities
Evaluate AI and machine learning techniques while balancing accuracy, scalability, and cost
Design solutions for large-scale use, identifying where sophisticated models add value and where more efficient approaches can achieve comparable results
Improve Experimentation & Model Quality
Develop robust approaches to measuring match quality, including precision, recall, false positives, false negatives, confidence, coverage, and manual review requirements
Help build trusted benchmark datasets to compare new approaches with existing matching methods before production rollout
Explore LLM-assisted review and validation both as a matching technique and as a benchmark for more scalable approaches
Translate ambiguous matching challenges into clear hypotheses, experiments, metrics, and recommendations

Location: Madrid, Spain

Owning and evolving Corestream, Kharon's risk intelligence feed — a dynamic platform that surfaces entity-level insights and topic-based risk narratives to customers

Tweaking and optimizing the metrics that define search quality and narrative relevance


Qualifications


A proven interest or experience in global security, financial crimes, sanctions, export controls, or related domains
3+ years of experience in a Data Science or AI Engineering role
Hands-on experience with semantic search — including familiarity with BM25, vector search, reranking, and retrieval evaluation
Experience with RAG pipelines and working with agentic systems in production
Proficiency in Python and SQL
Strong product alignment — able to read a roadmap, take ownership of tickets, and drive initiatives forward independently
Bonus: Experience with graph-aware search or integrating knowledge graph outputs into retrieval systems

Kharon operates at the nexus of global security and is on a mission to revolutionize the current landscape. Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Madrid, Portugal | Client-facing consultancy role




Join a leading global management and technology consultancy where you’ll work alongside experienced consultants, data experts and client teams to solve complex business challenges through data, advanced analytics and machine learning




As a Data Scientist, you’ll use data to uncover insights, solve challenging business problems and identify new opportunities for organisations across different industries. This is a hands-on role combining technical data science expertise with problem-solving, collaboration and client interactio




The Opportunity

Based in Madrid, you’ll work as part of a multidisciplinary consulting environment and support projects for clients across different locations. The role involves regular travel to client sites, with approximately 4 days of travel/on-site client work per week. Client locations may vary depending on the project and business requirements. All reasonable travel and accommodation expenses related to client work will be covered.




What You’ll Do

Work with consulting teams and clients to understand complex business challenges and translate them into data-driven solutions.
Analyse large and complex datasets to identify patterns, trends, opportunities and risks.
Use Python extensively for data processing, analysis and developing data science solutions.
Write SQL queries to extract, transform and analyse data from relational databases.
Build, train, test and evaluate machine learning models to solve real-world business problems.
Apply statistical, data-mining and advanced analytical techniques to generate actionable insights.
Develop algorithms and analytical approaches to address complex or previously undefined problems.
Translate technical findings into clear, practical recommendations for clients and business stakeholders.
Collaborate with consultants, data engineers, analysts and client teams.
Present complex analytical concepts and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.




What We’re Looking For

Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Statistics, Applied Mathematics or another quantitative discipline.
Strong hands-on experience with Python, particularly for data processing, analysis and data science development.
Strong SQL skills, including writing queries and extracting data from relational databases.
Practical Machine Learning experience, including building, training, testing and evaluating models.
Good understanding of statistical and data-mining techniques.
Experience working with large and complex data sets.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify root causes and develop effective solutions.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical concepts to business and non-technical stakeholders.
A collaborative, adaptable and commercially minded approach.
Comfortable working in a consulting and client-facing environment.
Willingness and availability to travel regularly to client sites, approximately 4 days per week, depending on project requirements.




If you’re a hands-on Data Scientist with strong Python, SQL and Machine Learning experience and you’re excited by the opportunity to work on challenging projects with leading organisations, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now and take the next step in your Data Science career.

Madrid, Portugal | Client-facing consultancy role


Join a leading global management and technology consultancy where you’ll work alongside experienced consultants, data experts and client teams to solve complex business challenges through data, advanced analytics and machine learning


As a Data Scientist, you’ll use data to uncover insights, solve challenging business problems and identify new opportunities for organisations across different industries. This is a hands-on role combining technical data science expertise with problem-solving, collaboration and client interactio


The Opportunity

Based in Madrid, you’ll work as part of a multidisciplinary consulting environment and support projects for clients across different locations. The role involves regular travel to client sites, with approximately 4 days of travel/on-site client work per week. Client locations may vary depending on the project and business requirements. All reasonable travel and accommodation expenses related to client work will be covered.


What You’ll Do

  • Work with consulting teams and clients to understand complex business challenges and translate them into data-driven solutions.
  • Analyse large and complex datasets to identify patterns, trends, opportunities and risks.
  • Use Python extensively for data processing, analysis and developing data science solutions.
  • Write SQL queries to extract, transform and analyse data from relational databases.
  • Build, train, test and evaluate machine learning models to solve real-world business problems.
  • Apply statistical, data-mining and advanced analytical techniques to generate actionable insights.
  • Develop algorithms and analytical approaches to address complex or previously undefined problems.
  • Translate technical findings into clear, practical recommendations for clients and business stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with consultants, data engineers, analysts and client teams.
  • Present complex analytical concepts and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.


What We’re Looking For

  • Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Statistics, Applied Mathematics or another quantitative discipline.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Python, particularly for data processing, analysis and data science development.
  • Strong SQL skills, including writing queries and extracting data from relational databases.
  • Practical Machine Learning experience, including building, training, testing and evaluating models.
  • Good understanding of statistical and data-mining techniques.
  • Experience working with large and complex data sets.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify root causes and develop effective solutions.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical concepts to business and non-technical stakeholders.
  • A collaborative, adaptable and commercially minded approach.
  • Comfortable working in a consulting and client-facing environment.
  • Willingness and availability to travel regularly to client sites, approximately 4 days per week, depending on project requirements.


If you’re a hands-on Data Scientist with strong Python, SQL and Machine Learning experience and you’re excited by the opportunity to work on challenging projects with leading organisations, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now and take the next step in your Data Science career.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Are you looking for a new challenge?

Fancy helping us shape the future of motor insurance?

Prima could be the place for you.

Since 2015, we’ve been using our love of data and tech to rethink motor insurance and bring drivers a great experience at a great price. Our story began in Italy, where we’ve quickly become the number one online motor insurance provider. In fact, we’re trusted by over 5 million drivers. And now we’re expanding to help millions more drivers in the UK and Spain.

To help fuel that growth, we’re looking for Data Scientists to join our Pricing & Underwriting Department, the strategic engine behind Prima's growth.

As part of this global team, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping our strategy and strengthening our competitive edge. Using data, analytical thinking, machine learning and business acumen, you’ll help predict the future and set the right prices, keeping our offering both attractive and sustainable. You’ll work with your data science tools and skills to bring real-world impact, collaborating with cross-functional teams to turn insights into action and fuel innovation across the company and its different branches.

Excited to make an impact? Here are the details.

What You’ll Do


Leverage data to identify risks, opportunities and key pricing drivers, turning complex information into actionable insights that influence strategic decision making;
Leverage Machine Learning and advanced analytics to develop risk and pricing models that power real-time insurance pricing for millions of customers;
Contribute directly to the company’s growth and long-term success through innovative modelling, experimentation and commercially impactful insights.


What We’re Looking For


Strong academic background in Mathematics, Physics, Engineering (Maths, Physics and Computer Science specialisations), Data Science, Computer Science or Statistics;
Strong quantitative, logical and analytical abilities, a solid foundation in statistics, probability and advanced analytics, and a curious, proactive and innovative mindset focused on solving complex problems;
Fluency in English, both spoken and written.


Nice-to-Have


Strong communication skills, with the ability to challenge assumptions, and drive new ideas;
Possess a solid foundation in code development and machine learning, ideally in Python;
Know how to create, manipulate and analyse large datasets.


€38,000 - €75,000 a year

Why you'll love it here

We want to make Prima a happy and empowering place to work. So if you decide to join us, you can expect plenty of perks.

💵Competitive compensation: Benefit from competitive salaries, starting from €38k up to €75k, with clear opportunities to grow as you do.

🤸 Work Your Way: Enjoy full flexibility – work from home, the office or a mix of both. Plus, work from anywhere for up to 30 days a year.

🏁 Grow with us: We may move fast at Prima, but we move together. Get access to learning resources, mentorship and a growth plan tailored to you.

🌈 Thrive and perform: Your best work begins when you feel your best. Enjoy private healthcare, gym discounts, wellbeing programs and mental health support.

Think you’re a match? Apply now.

At Prima, we celebrate uniqueness. If you don’t meet every requirement but are passionate about this role, we still want to hear from you. Innovation thrives on diverse perspectives.

Prima is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Need accommodations during the process? Email us at accessible.recruiting@prima.it. Let’s build the future of insurance, together.

Title: Specialist Data Science & Analytics
Description:
Join Us

At Vodafone, we’re not just shaping the future of connectivity for our customers – we’re shaping the future for everyone who joins our team. When you work with us, you’re part of a global mission to connect people, solve complex challenges, and create a sustainable and more inclusive world. If you want to grow your career whilst finding the perfect balance between work and life, Vodafone offers the opportunities to help you belong and make a real impact.

Role Purpose


Identify opportunities to improve business outcomes using analytical techniques, working with Local Markets and Group to understand their requirements and find and/or develop appropriate analytical products
Build and deliver data science and GenAI models that drive value following best-practices and standards (revenue upturn, cost decrease and/or customer & employee engagement improvements)
Build and deliver automations which will help digital transformation of stakeholders
Partner with Product Manager & delivery teams within VOIS to deliver analytics solutions
Create, own and maintain reusable data science products and services that can be deployed across Vodafone
Drive innovation by employing new analytical techniques



Who You Are

Key accountabilities and decision ownership:


Stakeholder management and engagement with new stakeholders from Group and OpCos to address their analytics needs and shape and define our Analytics Products/Projects Portfolio based on these requirements
Ensure best-practices and standards for software development in Data Science are followed across the wider team
Own specification and delivery of analytical products and services
Manage analytics portfolio and products by continuous improvement of existing products and developing new products based on stakeholder needs
Develop new analytics solutions through descriptive, GenAI, predictive and/or prescriptive analytics techniques
Manage delivery through partner organisation in DAIS (Data & Analytics Integrated Services in Vodafone Shared Services)
Maintain data sources and models up to date
Maintain up to date knowledge and emerging trends in analytics and challenge the status quo



Key performance indicators:


Value created from delivery of analytics products and projects
Efficiency of delivery (return on investment) given by the standardization of the solutions delivered
Rate of innovations introduced to the company (focus areas of ML/GenAI/Automation)



What's In It For You

Core competencies, knowledge and experience:


Experience in agile way of working
Strong communication skills with ability to influence senior stakeholders
Storytelling with data



Must have technical / professional qualifications:


Hands‑on proficiency in Python for data analysis, automation, and AI/ML solution development, following software engineering best practices (version control, modular design, reusable components)
Practical experience with any Cloud (GCP, Azure, AWS)
Working knowledge of Machine Learning and GenAI solutions
Experience defining, building and supporting end‑to‑end analytics or AI products, from requirements gathering and design through to preproduction and production deployment
Proven experience collaborating across business, IT and delivery team



Benefits


Hybrid work model
Bonus on top of the gross salary
Flexible working hours from Monday to Thursday, and an intensive schedule on Fridays
Intensive Summer Schedule during July and August
Up to 20 days per year of 100% remote work from other locations
Private Health and Life Insurance for employees and Family
25 vacation days, plus December 24th and 31st off
Optional Pension Plan
Access to an online learning platform for continuous training



REF: 281931

Please, apply with an English version of your CV.

Not a perfect fit?

Worried that you don’t meet all the desired criteria exactly? At Vodafone we are passionate about empowering people and creating a workplace where everyone can thrive, whatever their personal or professional background. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align exactly with every part of the job description, we encourage you to still apply as you may be the right candidate for this role or another opportunity.

Who We Are

We are a leading international Telco, serving millions of customers. At Vodafone, we believe that connectivity is a force for good. If we use it for the things that really matter, it can improve people's lives and the world around us. Through our technology we empower people, connecting everyone regardless of who they are or where they live and we protect the planet, whilst helping our customers do the same.

Belonging at Vodafone isn't a concept; it's lived, breathed, and cultivated through everything we do. You'll be part of a global and diverse community, with many different minds, abilities, backgrounds and cultures. ;We're committed to increase diversity, ensure equal representation, and make Vodafone a place everyone feels safe, valued and included.

If you require any reasonable adjustments or have an accessibility request as part of your recruitment journey, for example, extended time or breaks in between online assessments, please refer to https://careers.vodafone.com/application-adjustments/ for guidance.

Together we can.

Title: Data Scientist
HTML:
About the Role

We are looking for a Senior/Lead Data Scientist to develop predictive models and quantitative analytics that power risk-based vulnerability prioritization within a large-scale enterprise security program. You will structure and analyze massive security telemetry datasets, build ML algorithms to eliminate scanning noise and false positives, and establish unified data dashboards to drive adoption of data-driven security governance. The role requires 5+ years of data science experience with direct commercial application to vulnerability management, operating with full autonomy.


What you will do

  • Develop predictive models and quantitative analytics to prioritize vulnerabilities based on contextual risk and business impact;
  • Structure and analyze massive outputs of security data from across the enterprise ecosystem to support the ASPM framework;
  • Create machine learning algorithms or statistical models to automatically identify and filter out scanning noise and false positives;
  • Establish a unified data delivery structure and dashboards to drive the adoption of data-driven security governance.


Must haves

  • 5+ years of commercial data science experience, operating completely autonomously with no required supervision;
  • Advanced proficiency in Python, R, and SQL;
  • Experience with machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow and PyTorch;
  • Experience with data visualization tools;
  • Commercial experience applying data science to vulnerability management;
  • Upper-intermediate English level.


Nice to haves

  • Familiarity with Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) data outputs (e.g., Wiz).


Perks and Benefits

  • Professional growth

Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps

  • Competitive compensation

We match your ever-growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD-based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities

  • A selection of exciting projects

Join projects with modern solutions development and top-tier clients that include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands

  • Flextime

Tailor your schedule for an optimal work-life balance, by having the options of working from home and going to the office – whatever makes you the happiest and most productive.

Title: Data Scientist - People Analytics
Description:
En ABB, ayudamos a las industrias a superar su capacidad productiva, de forma más eficiente y limpia. Aquí, el progreso es una expectativa para usted, su equipo y el mundo. Como líder global del mercado, le brindaremos lo que necesita para lograrlo. No siempre será fácil; crecer requiere agallas. Pero en ABB, nunca trabajará solo. Dirige lo que dirige el mundo.

Este Puesto Reporta a

Head of HR Experience and Operations

What We Believe In

ABB is a worldwide provider of electrification and automation solutions, enabling a more sustainable and resource-efficient future. By combining its engineering know-how and digital capabilities, ABB helps industries run at high performance while improving efficiency, productivity, and sustainability so they can outperform. We call this ‘Engineered to Outrun’

The company has over 140 years of history and more than 105,000 employees worldwide. ABB’s shares are listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange (ABBN) and Nasdaq Stockholm (ABB).

At ABB, we are committed to advancing diversity and inclusion across all dimensions: gender, LGBTQ+, abilities, ethnicity, and generations. We welcome and celebrates individual differences to create a future where innovative digital technologies allow greater access to cleaner energy.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As part of the People Analytics team, the Data Scientist will contribute to a resourceful, quick-reacting group that supplies dependable, high-quality analytics to business and HR leaders to support Talent, Performance, and Culture planning.

Reporting to the Team Lead or Global Head of People Analytics, you will be responsible for delivering global projects that improve workforce decision-making at ABB

The work model for the role is: Hybrid

You Will Be Mainly Accountable For


Partner with cross-functional and global teams to lead analytics projects that solve complex business problems, managing the end-to-end lifecycle from requirement gathering and data extraction to analysis and presenting insights.
Develop advanced statistical and machine learning models using techniques such as regression, clustering, forecasting, decision trees, neural networks, and other data mining methods to generate actionable insights.
Leverage programming languages and platforms such as Python, R, Snowflake, NoSQL, and data lakes to build predictive models, scalable frameworks, and machine learning solutions.
Translate people and business data into meaningful insights by defining People KPIs and creating impactful visualizations using tools such as Power BI, Advanced Excel, VBA, and other analytics technologies.
Oversee strategic analytics projects focused on workforce performance, cultural development, and employee experience, applying NLP and deep learning techniques to interpret unstructured data and deliver creative outcomes.


Qualifications For The Role


Demonstrate initiative, solid quantitative skills, and comfort working with large datasets to extract insights that support strategic decision-making.
Demonstrate programming and coding experience in R, Python, or MS Azure for analytics and data science solutions.
Possess practical experience with Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, and Natural Language Processing.
Understand concepts related to SDLC and ETL processes involved in data management and analytics projects.
Demonstrate a high level of skill in recognizing data patterns and crafting persuasive narratives from fragmented or complex datasets.
Experience developing end-to-end decision science solutions including data modeling, ETL, and reporting, with consulting exposure.
Have a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Applied Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Operations Research, or a related area, along with proficient English communication, quantitative, and technical skills; knowledge of SAP or Workday HCM systems would be beneficial


More About Us

Our goal in ABB IS (Information Systems) is to leverage information technology to provide valuable, reliable, and competitive IS services for ABB. If you have demonstrable technical skills, a structured mindset, and the motivation to help us stay ahead of the competition, you are the person we are looking for.

Nunca solicitamos dinero a los solicitantes de empleo.

Title: Threat Intel Data Scientist
Description:
Can you imagine taking part in the transformation of leading national and international organizations?




At Deloitte, we are committed to making an impact on society, our clients, and our people.

As part of the Global Centralized Cybersecurity Threat Intelligence team, the Data Scientist reports to the Processing and Data Science Manager and is part of the Operations function.

In this role, you will design and develop AI-driven solutions to automate the processing, normalization, enrichment, and analysis of internal and external threat intelligence data. You will work with large-scale structured and unstructured datasets, applying Data Science, Machine Learning, and Generative AI to improve cybersecurity intelligence products and analytical workflows used across Deloitte globally.




Candidates with backgrounds in Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Analytics, Engineering, Research, or related fields are encouraged to apply. Prior cybersecurity experience is a plus but not required, as domain knowledge can be developed through collaboration and training.




The team

Deloitte Technology operates at the forefront of innovation, supporting and protecting Deloitte globally through advanced technology solutions. We foster a collaborative, global environment where innovation and continuous learning drive meaningful impact.

📍Madrid




Key responsibilities

Design, develop, and continuously improve AI and Machine Learning solutions to support cybersecurity analysts and intelligence-driven decision making.
Transform, normalize, and enrich intelligence data from multiple internal and external sources into the Threat Intelligence Platform (TIP) and related intelligence tools.
Apply Data Science, AI, and Generative AI technologies (LLMs, RAG, semantic search, embeddings, prompt engineering, etc.) to automate and enhance threat intelligence products and analytical workflows.
Analyze large-scale structured and unstructured datasets to identify patterns, relationships, anomalies, and emerging cyber threats through advanced analytics, correlation, and clustering techniques.
Identify and integrate new intelligence data sources to enrich cyber threat analysis and improve analytical capabilities.
Create and maintain technical documentation and SOPs to support scalable and well-governed solutions.




What we're looking for

4+ years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, Analytics, Data Engineering, or similar technical fields.
Strong programming skills in Python and SQL, including experience working with APIs and data processing pipelines.
Hands-on experience developing and deploying Machine Learning and AI solutions, with a solid understanding of statistical modeling and large-scale data analysis.
Experience with Generative AI technologies, including LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, semantic search, or related AI applications.
Experience working with large structured and unstructured datasets and communicating analytical insights through data visualization.
Familiarity with cloud environments such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform.
Experience with modern data platforms and development practices (e.g., Databricks, Spark, Snowflake, Vector Databases, Git, MLOps/LLMOps) is a plus.
Exposure to cybersecurity, threat intelligence, or security analytics is beneficial but not required.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with professional proficiency in English.




What is it like to work at Deloitte?

🤩 High-impact projects offering long-term growth and continuous learning opportunities.

☯️ Hybrid and flexible working model, with flexible hours and a healthy balance between remote work and collaboration in our offices or at client sites.

Description:
Kapsch is one of Austria's most successful global technology companies. With its

comprehensive ITS (Intelligent Transportation Systems) portfolio, Kapsch is actively addressing

the challenges of the present and the future with intelligent mobility solutions in a wide range

of application areas. As a family-owned company founded in 1892 and headquartered in

our solutions and innovations, visit our website here.

We are looking for a Data Scientist with experience developing machine learning solutions and analytical models, from experimentation to validated production-ready models. You will work closely with the Product Owner, Data Engineers, MLOps Engineers, and Data Analysts to transform business challenges into scalable AI solutions and data products.

What You’ll Do


Design, develop, and validate machine learning models through iterative experimentation and PoC cycles.
Work directly with customers and stakeholders to understand business problems, define use cases, KPIs, and success criteria.
Develop forecasting, predictive, and analytical models, with strong focus on time series use cases.
Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Data Engineers, Data Analysts, and MLOps Engineers to deliver AI and ML solutions efficiently.
Perform feature engineering, model validation, and model performance analysis.
Build demo-ready PoCs and visualizations to communicate results and insights to stakeholders.
Track experiments, metrics, and model evolution using MLflow.
Work with analytical datasets and contribute to the definition of datasets and features for ML use cases.
Contribute to technical standards, best practices, and AI/ML solution design.


What We’re Looking For


4+ years of experience as a Data Scientist, ML Engineer, or similar role focused on analytical and ML solutions.
Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field.
Strong background in machine learning.
Experience managing ML experimentation cycles, model lifecycle, and production model maintenance, using tools such as MLflow or similar.
Proficiency in Python and experience working with SQL.
Experience working with analytical databases and large datasets.
Familiarity with orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow and notebook-based experimentation workflows.
Strong English communication skills, both written and spoken.
Analytical mindset, fast learner, collaborative attitude, and customer-oriented approach.
Experience working in Agile environments.


Our offer


Permanent role.
Hybrid working model (3 days of remote work/week).
Flexible working hours.
30 business days of annual leave.
Flexible remuneration plan.

Title: Data Scientist - Fintech
Description:
Ebury helps ambitious businesses unlock global growth, and we take the same approach with our people. We encourage innovation and movement, collaboration and problem-solving, and foster an environment where everyone can feel they belong, are valued, supported and empowered to succeed.

If you’re a collaborator who wants to help transform how businesses operate globally, get in touch - we’d love to discuss how Ebury can accelerate your career so you can shape the future.

Data Scientist - Growth

Location: Madrid (Hybrid: 4 days office / 1 day WFH)

Stack: Python, SQL, GCP (BigQuery, AI Platform, Cloud Functions), ML Libraries, CRM (Salesforce), LLMs.

Why This Role Exists

Ebury is executing an ambitious strategic growth plan across multiple business verticals. To power this expansion, we need to bridge the gap between advanced data science and real-world sales execution. This role exists to drive innovation in Growth modelling and deliver the actionable, data-driven insights that fuel our global sales engine.

Today, optimizing sales performance requires continuous experimentation and refining how we identify commercial opportunities. Tomorrow, we want to scale and seamlessly integrate our predictive models—such as Lead Scoring, conversion, and profitability models—directly into our sales enablement platforms so our teams can make faster, smarter, and highly optimized decisions every day.

What You'll Own 📌

Growth Modelling & Predictive Analytics


Drive innovation in Growth modelling by identifying opportunities for improvement, experimenting with new methodologies, and continuously refining models to enhance accuracy and performance.
Develop and refine models for sales enablement and growth, using Python to drive better sales performance and decision-making. These models include, but are not limited to: Lead Scoring models, conversion models, profitability models, etc.
Analyse and optimise sales data to identify patterns, trends, and opportunities that enhance lead scoring and sales strategies, contributing to overall business growth.


Cross-Functional Integration & Tool Adoption


Collaborate with Data Engineers and Sales Analysts to integrate models into sales enablement platforms, ensuring the delivery of actionable insights to sales teams and business stakeholders.
Support the adoption of advanced analytics tools within the sales team, providing clear guidance on model outputs while working closely with senior data scientists for continuous improvement and learning.


What You Bring

Must-Have


2+ years of experience in Data Science or related roles
Proficiency in Python and extensive experience with machine learning libraries.
Solid understanding of statistical methods and machine learning models, with the clear ability to interpret model results and rigorously assess their performance.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work closely with data engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders to translate complex data insights into actionable business strategies.
Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams (including Data Engineers, Sales Analysts, and business stakeholders) to ensure models align perfectly with business objectives.
A problem-solving mindset with the ability to identify data-driven solutions to complex sales and growth challenges, helping optimize sales strategies and decision-making processes.
Self-motivation and curiosity, with a strong desire to learn and grow in a fast-paced environment, continuously improving both technical and business skills.
Fluency in English (Spanish is a plus).


Highly Valued


Experience with GCP (Google Cloud Platform) tools and services, such as BigQuery, AI Platform, and Cloud Functions, for deploying scalable data solutions.
Experience with A/B testing or experimentation frameworks is a plus, particularly for optimising sales strategies based on model performance.
Knowledge of sales analytics and CRM systems, understanding how data insights can improve lead quality and sales outcomes (familiarity with tools like Salesforce is a plus).
Expertise in leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) for processing unstructured data, such as text analysis and sentiment analysis, to enhance risk assessment and decision-making.
Proficiency in SQL for querying and managing large datasets, as well as experience working with both structured and unstructured data sources.
Previous hands-on experience building lead scoring models, Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) models, and churn models.


What We Offer


Competitive Salary + Performance-based discretionary bonus.
Other Benefits: Private health insurance, flexible remuneration, and a day off on your birthday.
Career Progression: A well-structured career path with clear opportunities for growth.
Vibrant Culture: Join a collaborative environment in our Madrid office where Data Engineers, Data Scientists, Analytics Engineers, and Analysts work as one.
Continuous Learning: Personal development through certifications and specialized training.


About Us

Ebury delivers sophisticated, integrated solutions — business accounts, hedging, and financing — on a single platform with a seamless workflow. Our success is built on a simple premise and singular purpose: To help businesses operate and scale globally.

Since its founding in 2009, Ebury has always been a fast-growing leader in fintech. Today, we bring together 2000+ Eburians across nearly 70 cities and we’re always looking to add to our team.

At the heart of our offering is a proprietary platform, purpose-built to help businesses seamlessly streamline and manage global cash flow. We focus on continuous product evolution and innovation to build the infrastructure for borderless growth and help our clients scale at every stage.

The opportunities at Ebury are as diverse as our people, ranging from business development to engineering roles across our tech pillars.

We believe in inclusion. We stand against discrimination in all forms and are against the intolerance of differences that makes us a modern and successful organisation. At Ebury, you can be whoever you want to be and still feel a sense of belonging no matter your story.

Important Security Notice For Job Applicants

Ebury only accepts applications via official Ebury channels. We will only contact you from an @ebury.com domain. Always check the emails you receive from us, and note that we will never request payment for any part of the recruitment process. Stay safe and report suspicious activity.

Notice To Recruitment Agencies And Search Firms

Ebury does not accept unsolicited resumes, CVs, or candidate profiles from recruitment agencies or search firms without signed written Ebury recruitment terms in place for a specific role. Any unsolicited applications will be considered the sole property of Ebury. Ebury will not be responsible or liable for any placement fees or costs associated with unagreed candidate submissions or subsequent hires.

AI Transparency Statement

Ebury uses Artificial Intelligence (AI) and automated tools to help streamline certain parts of our recruitment process, however, these tools are strictly for administrative efficiency. All hiring decisions, including application reviews, shortlisting, and final selections are evaluated and conducted by human talent acquisition professionals and hiring managers.

Title: Data Scientist - Fraud Detection
Description:
Are you looking for a new challenge?

Fancy helping us shape the future of motor insurance?

Prima could be the place for you.

Since 2015, we’ve been using our love of data and tech to rethink motor insurance and bring drivers a great experience at a great price. Our story began in Italy, where we’ve quickly become the number one online motor insurance provider. In fact, we’re trusted by over 5 million drivers. And now we’re expanding to help millions more drivers in the UK and Spain.

To help fuel that growth, we need a Data Scientist to join our Anti Fraud Team.

In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to tackle fraud, one of the most impactful and fast-evolving challenges in insurance. You will do this from a global perspective. In fact, the team is responsible for detecting fraudulent claims across all Prima markets: the UK, Spain and Italy.

You’ll collaborate with engineers, claims handlers and business leaders to improve the detection of fraud, directly influencing real-world fraud decisions with impact on the company’s bottom line measured in millions. This is a highly practical area of work where strong business judgment is just as important as technical expertise.

Excited to make an impact? Here are the details

What You’ll Do


Design and improve fraud detection systems that prioritize high-risk claims, optimizing the trade-off between detection accuracy and operational efficiency
Collaborate across teams and functions, working closely with fraud analysts, engineers, and product managers
Develop deep expertise in fraud dynamics, identifying emerging fraud patterns, understanding how they evolve across the insurance lifecycle, and translating these insights into effective detection and prevention strategies, for example identifying suspicious networks of related claims, synthetic entities, or anomalous behavioral patterns


What We’re Looking For


Extensive experience (3+ years) in data science or applied machine learning, leading end-to-end initiatives in complex technical domains and delivering measurable business impact
Strong analytical and quantitative mindset able to translate data into insights, assess model performance, and guide decision-making with evidence and clarity
Structured problem solver skilled at framing ambiguous challenges, defining success metrics, and communicating results to both technical and non-technical audiences
Strong Python programming skills, especially in the data domain, and fluent use of Git
Knowledge of Spark, SQL or any other data-oriented programming language and proficiency with standard data wrangling and modeling libraries (Pandas, Sklearn, Keras, XGBoost, LightGBM, etc.)


Nice-to-Have


Experience in analytical fraud detection in the Insurance, Finance or Law Enforcement domain
In-depth knowledge of graph databases (Neo4j, AWS Neptune) and analytics (NetworkX, GNN) or explainability applied to anomaly detection
Knowledge of BI tools (Tableau or similar)


€45,000 - €65,000 a year

Why you’ll love it here

We want to make Prima a happy and empowering place to work. So if you decide to join us, you can expect plenty of perks.

💵 Competitive compensation: We offer a performance-based bonus of up to 5% of the fixed salary for this position.

🤸 Work Your Way: Enjoy hybrid working, with a mix of home and office days. Plus, for up to 30 days per year, work from anywhere.

🏁 Grow with us: We may move fast at Prima, but we move together. Get access to learning resources, mentorship and a growth plan tailored to you.

🌈 Thrive and perform: Your best work begins when you feel your best. Enjoy private healthcare, gym discounts, wellbeing programs and mental health support.

Think you’re a match? Apply now.

At Prima, we celebrate uniqueness. If you don’t meet every requirement but are passionate about this role, we still want to hear from you. Innovation thrives on diverse perspectives.

Prima is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Need accommodations during the process? Email us at accessible.recruiting@prima.it. Let’s build the future of insurance, together.
